abstract: Gene Expression Nebulas (GEN; https://ngdc.cncb.ac.cn/gen/) is an open-access database that provides standardized transcriptomic profiles and manually curated metadata across diverse species. Compared with the previous release, the updated GEN has expanded in terms of datasets from 323 to 668, samples from 50 500 to 102 679, cells from 15 540 169 to 23 461 252, and species from 30 to 100. GEN 2.0 adds spatial transcriptomics data and disease-associated expression annotations from 82 human bulk RNA-seq datasets spanning 62 disease categories, including distinct subtypes, across 12 disease systems. In addition, it has been significantly upgraded by providing high-quality gene expression profiles for artificial intelligence applications, a web-based service to accept transcriptomic data submission, and an updated online analysis tool for gene expression comparisons across species, tissues, and diseases. Together, GEN offers more comprehensive, standardized gene expression profiles across diverse species and thus serves as a fundamental resource for uncovering molecular functional mechanisms and deciphering complex regulatory architecture.
